_comment: Affiliate Link Injection config (A-06, FR-6). Copy to a real file and point NORMALIZATION_AFFILIATE_CONFIG at it. Keys under 'stores' are scraper store ids (StoreConfig.store_id). 'template' is an optional deep-link wrapper with {url} (URL-encoded) / {url_raw} placeholders; 'params' are query parameters appended to the link and override default_params for that store.
